hi, i'm Sam. i run Iron Halo, a small powerlifting and strongman gym in Salford, Manchester. we've been at the current 12 Bridgewater Way location since 2019, before that we operated out of a unit in Trafford for two years.

we are not a normal gym. there are no machines you don't need, no televisions, no music piped in from corporate playlists. we have eight calibrated platforms, two competition deadlift bars, a yoke, a log, atlas stones, three sled tracks, and roughly 4 tonnes of plates. members come here to lift heavy in a focused, technically supervised environment. average member is 30, fairly even male/female split which surprises some people. lots of competitive powerlifters and strongman competitors — Hannah, our top female lifter, totalled 487.5kg at the British classic last month.

what we offer:
- coached programming. you don't show up and wing it. every member is on a written program from one of our two coaches (me and Eli). i'm IPF cat-2, Eli is BWL level 3.
- meet prep. we run cycles into specific competitions. last year we sent 9 lifters to nationals.
- open floor membership for serious independent lifters who don't need coaching but want the environment.
- strongman block on saturdays, weather depending (we use the loading bay)
- nutrition guidance — not a full coaching service, but we'll review your food log if you ask.

what we don't do: globo-gym packages, beginner "tone up" classes, fitness models, instagram-style training. we have turned away a lot of people. that's fine.

our member roster is full (78 members, hard cap at 80) so the site is really for waitlist applications and meet info. tone should match how we actually talk: direct, technical, no fluff. i think our voice is dry and a bit dark-humored. if it sounds like a marketing agency wrote it, throw it out.

oh — we sponsor four lifters and pay their meet fees. and we host two open competitions per year. that should probably be on the site somewhere.

contact: sam@ironhalo.co.uk, 0161 555 0192.
